caption: Duplicate and ambiguous ID groups retain source paths.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['task-id-audit']; p.pro.signOut(); const m = p.openAudit('Task ID Audit/Projects/Duplicates'); await m.refresh(); return m.report.issues.length; })()

caption: The project task resolves a completed target in Archive.

caption: Select a source to open its task line.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['task-id-audit']; p.pro.signOut(); p.modal?.close(); await p.openSource({ path: 'Task ID Audit/Projects/Targets/Links.md', line: 5 }); return 'source open'; })()

caption: Pro saves a project profile and an audit snapshot.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['task-id-audit']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('task-id-audit-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); p.settings = { profiles: [], reports: [] }; const m = p.openAudit('Task ID Audit/Projects/Cycles'); await m.refresh(); await p.saveProfile('Launch review', m.folder); await p.saveReport('Launch review', m.report); m.updatePro(); return 'profile and report saved'; })()

caption: Pro can repeat a report after Markdown file changes.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['task-id-audit']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('task-id-audit-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); const m = p.openAudit('Task ID Audit/Projects/Targets'); await m.refresh(); m.live = true; m.updatePro(); return 'repeat on'; })()
